title: Onboarding assistance requested for Northwind Robotics workspace setup
body:
Source: email E-017 from priya@northwind-robotics.example (received 2026-10-05T09:12:00Z), subject "Onboarding help".

Request: Northwind Robotics (C-104, Business plan, EU-West, onboarding stage: Kickoff scheduled) reports that their admins have not been able to complete the initial workspace setup and are asking for a walkthrough this week.

Suggested follow-up: assign an onboarding specialist to contact Priya and schedule a guided workspace setup session this week.
label: Internal
